information: This is the national and biggest cube competition in Indonesia. This year Indonesian Championship will be held in Surabaya, 2nd largest city in Indonesia. Indonesian Championship is open to all nationalities. The registration fee is divided into 4 categories, please check payment tab for more detail. For further information you can contact the contact person.
